comments.quote: 房間很乾凈很寬敞，門口有小院子能停車，房子前面有院子可以玩，泳池也很不錯，我們還玩了水，訂了老闆家的一桌菜，很好吃。總之非常滿意的一次出行，下次還會再來。團建什麼的整租也合適的
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The room is very clean and roomy, there is a small courtyard at the gate where you can park, and another in front of the house to sit in. The pool is good and we swam. We ordered a table of food from the owner and it was very good. A thoroughly satisfying trip and I will come back. Taking the whole place would work for a group.
